about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing families left in the cold with nowhere to turn.
about_para_1: Gary Hill Heating and Plumbing has been serving Wolverhampton and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. Founded on a simple principle—turn up when you say you'll turn up, do the job right, and charge a fair price—we've built a reputation for honest, dependable work. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully trained in modern heating systems.
about_para_2: We're proud that the majority of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations. Whether it's a 2am emergency or a planned upgrade, you'll get the same level of care and attention. We've fixed thousands of Wolverhampton homes, and we know the area well.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a frozen boiler in January. Gary was round within the hour, thawed it out, and explained what I needed to do to prevent it happening again. Cost was fair, and no silly call-out charges. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Fitted a complete new central heating system. Very professional team, minimal mess, and they cleaned up properly after. System's running beautifully and the warranty is brilliant. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Burst pipe at half past midnight on New Year's Eve. Gary answered the phone himself, came out straightaway, and had it sorted before 2am. Couldn't ask for better service. You're lifesavers.
reviews.author: James L.
